rows.what_the_ink_shows: The first coefficient is retraced darker blue over faint writing and has more than one low bend before its prime. The second is a flatter pale letter with a low loop and extended horizontal portion before its prime. Printed musical staff lines run directly through both letters; comparison with the n-prime and m-prime definitions on the following line does not securely distinguish the two readings. See crops/137_scan025_L390.jpg and crops/137_scan025_L390_definitions.jpg.
rows.note: Retain the existing t\unsure{m'|n'} on Psi^i and t\unsure{n'|m'} on Psi^{i-1}. The row selects n-prime then m-prime by re-derivation, but the actual ink remains ambiguous because of retracing and intersecting staff lines; it does not justify converting those alternatives to definite text. This is a mathematical reading preference carried as a note, not a settled optical misreading. No re-derivation was independently performed.
